snippet.title: Lami: A Cup of Code & Coffee - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Inheriting Grandpa’s Old Café… and Meeting a Cute Robot Girl?!
Use all your skills to develop unique gadgets and run the café alongside the adorable Lami. 
Face exciting challenges and gradually uncover Lami’s story.  

💖 Add to your Steam Wishlist now! 💖  
🔗 powered.com/app/3196150/Lami_A_Cup_of_Code__Coffee/
